title: Staging branches build on demand, not on every push (TI, Pilobol.us, Anth.us, p.apyr.us)
description:
Facts: `staging` (BETA) branches have auto-build ON for threat-intelligence-cms, pilobol-us-cms, anth-us-cms, p-apyr-us-cms. Unknown share of the 542 builds: measure first.
Steps:
1. Measure: `aws amplify list-jobs --app-id <id> --branch-name staging` for the last 30 days per app; sum minutes; post the numbers on this story (read-only).
2. Decide with the data (no fixed cap): if staging builds are a material share (expected 10–20%), set `enableAutoBuild: false` for the staging branch in `amplify-app-shell.ts` (line ~262 today hard-codes `true`) behind `cms.staging.buildOnPush: false` in site-config, and add a way to start one: `workflow_dispatch` input `branch-name: staging` on the site's deploy workflow (the reusable `amplify-deploy.yml` already takes `branch-name`), plus the GithubDeployRole allowing StartJob on the staging branch too.
3. Redeploy affected app-shell stacks (CDK write, Ryan's approval; pre-prod sites move fast).
Acceptance: pushing to `staging` no longer starts a job; `gh workflow run deploy.yml -f branch-name=staging` does; Gherkin in Papyrus features: "staging builds start only on request". Record the before/after minutes.
